sub_limits_waiting_notes: Morbid Obesity: 3 years. Refractive Error: 2 years. Spouse covered at 50-80 years if other spouse already a senior citizen. Maximum entry age 80; lifelong renewability.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured with Plan-wise room/ICU caps
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Issued on Individual or Floater basis; covers allopathy + AYUSH

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Both plans; min 3 days; first 7 days domiciliary then post-hospitalisation

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Per Transplantation of Human Organs Act 1994

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Plan B only - Reinstatement of SI if exhausted due to RTA

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Plan A: block of 2 years. Plan B: block of 6 months (also covers OPD consultation)
preventive_health_checkup.notes: Continuous renewal required; up to Table of Benefits limit

room_rent_capping: Plan A: 1% of SI per day (max INR 5,000). Plan B: 2% of SI per day (max INR 10,000). No cap if PPN packaged procedure.
icu_capping: Plan A: 2% of SI per day (max INR 10,000). Plan B: 4% of SI per day (max INR 20,000).
copayment_trigger_notes: Zone II premium paid + Zone I treatment = 18.5% copay. Optional copay: 20% or 10% with respective premium discounts.

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract_plan_a: 15% of SI or INR 75,000 per eye, lower
disease_wise_sub_limits.hazardous_sports: 25% of SI per any one illness

notable_exclusions_summary: Senior-citizen indemnity plan: NO maternity, NO infertility. 24-month PED wait. Zone I treatment by Zone II premium payer triggers 18.5% copay.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA, pre-auth 1 hour, final auth 3 hours. Reimbursement: notify 72h planned/24h emergency, submit documents within 30 days of discharge. Settlement: 15 days of last document.
